invented.quote: Our fresh food is limited by transportation, not supply.
invented.why: The brief states that the food bank had to turn down produce because it had no way to pick it up cold or store it, not because of transportation alone.

invented.quote: because cold transport is what stands between our clients and fresh food that is already available in our community.
invented.why: The brief says the food bank lacked both cold pickup and storage, so cold transport is not the only thing standing in the way.

invented.quote: The van will let us collect produce directly from farms and keep it cold until distribution.
invented.why: The brief states the food bank also had no way to store the produce, and does not say the van will be used to keep food cold until distribution.

invented.quote: for this grant, we will put every reporting deadline on our board calendar at the time of award and assign one named volunteer to prepare each report, with a board member responsible for submitting it on time.
invented.why: The brief does not mention that the food bank has a board of directors or a board calendar.

invented.quote: Much of the fresh food our neighbors need is grown a few miles away.
invented.why: The brief mentions 'local farms' but does not specify that they are 'a few miles away' or that they grow 'much of the fresh food' needed.
